name: Angel ★ Pop
source:
Main character is appointed to educate an angel. But he does not think he can be a good teacher. Why not teach him something bothersome instead and turn him into fallen angel?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公受命教育一名天使，却不认为自己能成为好老师。既然如此，何不教给他一些麻烦的东西，把他变成堕天使？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
